textual.context: The ASR appears to explain or demonstrate the program, but the supplied records do not establish whether the earnings statement is a guarantee, quotation, warning, or promotion.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated large-earnings outcome is linked in the same source to giving money and making an investment, which may require assessment of the claim and its conditions.
textual.limitations: The ASR contains apparent transcription errors and does not establish that anyone received the stated amounts or that an investment occurred.

textual.observation: The source describes user payments associated with PTP and a Trust Wallet, alongside selectable program slots with stated values.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish the recipient, transaction outcome, currency, complete amounts, or whether the displayed values represent required payments.

visual.observation: A presentation titled “CRYPTO KINGDOM Path to Financial Freedom” is followed by frames showing a “Registration in Forsage BUSD” interface alongside wallet balances and transaction screens. A later slide headed “No risk” / “WHY FORSAGE?” states that received funds are sent to “your wallet in 100% volume” and that each member can “earn thousands of dollars per month.”
visual.context: The material may be a promotional presentation or app demonstration, but the sampled frames do not establish whether viewers are directly instructed to register, pay, or transfer assets.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible registration workflow and wallet interaction are directly paired with claims of no risk, full wallet receipt, and substantial earnings, creating a promised-return relationship linked to a crypto registration/action that may merit review.
visual.limitations: Sparse samples do not establish that registration or payment was completed, that any earnings occurred, that the claims are accurate, or that the displayed app and wallet activity correspond to real transactions; no external site, identity, or outcome was verified.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as a crypto earnings program while presenting it as having 'No risk' and showing viewers how to register, select slots, and participate. The presentation describes Forsage as a multi-level marketing scheme, says a team is required, and instructs viewers to include people in their team, tying participation to recruitment rather than merely explaining blockchain technology. These assurances and recruitment instructions actively encourage participation in the earning opportunity.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video presents a multi-level structure involving slots, affiliate participation, and a required team, then instructs viewers to add people to that team. The recruitment relationship is central to the promoted earning mechanism, beyond a simple one-level referral or ordinary wallet tutorial.
